data.credibility: Management reliably delivers on core financial guidance like EBITDA margins and revenue growth. However, they frequently drop specific operational metrics and order inflow targets in subsequent quarters without providing final actuals, showing mixed transparency on granular guidance.

lines.line: Promised >27% EBITDA margin; delivered 29.2% for FY26.
Promised >INR 27,000 crores orders; topic dropped without actuals.
Promised >15% revenue growth; delivered 16.2% for FY26.
Promised INR 57,000 crores order inflow; topic dropped without actuals.
Promised >INR 1,600 crores R&D; topic dropped without actuals.
Targeted 3% to 4% export turnover; delivered 3.0% in Q3.
Targeted 5% export turnover in 2 to 3 years; on track.
Targeted >INR 2,000 crores FY27 R&D; on track.
Retained >15% revenue growth for FY27; on track.
Targeted >28% EBITDA margins for FY27; on track.
Targeted >INR 55,000 crores order inflow for FY27; on track.
Targeted >INR 1,200 crores capital investment; on track.
Targeted 90% defense to 10% non-defense ratio; on track.
Aimed for USD 300 million in export leads; pending.
